topic: Linear Transformations and Matrices: The Geometry of Change

sections.title: Intuition: From Vectors to Transformations
lecture_lines: Linear transformations move space, keeping origin fixed.
Grid lines remain parallel and evenly spaced.
Basis vector i lands at a new position.
Basis vector j lands at a new position.
Space deforms while origin stays perfectly pinned.
animations: Create 2D coordinate plane with basis vectors i(1,0) and j(0,1). (Color: #FFFFFF) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg]
Highlight i_hat in red (#FF0000) and j_hat in blue (#0000FF).
Animate basis vectors scaling and rotating to new positions.
Display the final transformed grid lines parallel and evenly spaced. [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg]
Overlay transformation matrix M next to the final grid. (Color: #FFFF00)

sections.title: The Matrix as a Transformation Recipe
lecture_lines: Matrices act as compact numerical transformation recipes.
Matrix columns show where i and j land.
First column tracks the landing of i.
Second column tracks the landing of j.
Vectors transform as linear combinations of these columns.
animations: Display matrix M = [[a, b], [c, d]] using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/recipe.svg]. (Color: #FFFF00)
Animate i_hat pointing to column 1: [a, c]. (Color: #FF0000)
Animate j_hat pointing to column 2: [b, d]. (Color: #0000FF)

sections.title: Visualizing Operations: Matrix-Vector Multiplication
lecture_lines: Matrix multiplication applies a transformation to a vector.
The resulting vector shows the transformed location.
Geometric warping maps input points to new coordinates.
animations: Show initial vector v = x*i + y*j on a background [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/grid.svg]. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Animate vector v decomposition into components x*i and y*j. (Color: #FFFF00)
Visualize the resulting vector Av ending at the final warped position plotted on a [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg]. (Color: #00FF00)

sections.title: Composition: Chaining Transformations
lecture_lines: Chaining transformations is equivalent to matrix multiplication.
Order matters: rotations before scaling differ by result.
animations: Show airplane [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/airplane.svg] undergoing first transformation T1 (e.g. Rotation).
Apply second transformation T2 to the already transformed plane.
Highlight the order of operations explicitly using the car [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/car.png]. (Color: #FF4500)
Show composite transformation as matrix multiplication T2*T1. (Color: #FFFFFF)
Display the final resulting position after both operations.

sections.title: Summary and Geometric Significance
lecture_lines: Matrices are instructions for precise spatial manipulation.
Determinants calculate the factor by which area scales.
Transformation geometry reveals the underlying linear logic.
